changes.text: Settings: one domain account shared by Exchange and Jira
Main window: events, local events, tasks and flagged mail in one time-ordered list
Main window: day dividers between past days, today and the next day
Exchange: show tasks due on the dimmed next day
Exchange: open meetings, tasks and flagged mail in the desktop Outlook when installed, left click opens a meeting
Kubernetes: resource commands — scale, restart, rollback, pause, run now, suspend, rerun, delete; events tab
Kubernetes: YAML highlighting, copy button icon, short context name
Kubernetes: notify when a pod in a watched namespace starts failing
Kubernetes: edit and save a resource's YAML when allowed in the settings
Kubernetes: switch the context in the main window, namespace per context
